integration.current_objective: parallel derelict research with isolated Surveyor variants

runtime-dispatch.next_action: Run RUNTIME-A on the known derelict until owner+0x10 dispatch capture succeeds; no traversal required.

seed-lineage.result_summary: Offline system-seed anchors implemented and verified; direct equality with known derelict root seeds was not found and no derivation is claimed.

dungeon-decompile.next_action: Run the offline NMS.exe anchor scan from DUNGEON-C and upload the result; game runtime is not required.

metadata.objective: Map abandoned-freighter component DungeonOptions/weights, DungeonRootScene, dungeon-table presets and static asset relationships without duplicating runtime/seed/decompile lanes.

new_agent_start.rule: Always read main first. Do not claim or modify an existing claimed agent branch unless explicitly assigned to that lane.
resume_order: the assigned lane manifest and only relevant files
new_agent_start.branch_rule: For a new independent task, create a fresh branch from current main named agent/<short-lane-id>. The pre-created agent/metadata branch is currently free and synchronized to main.
new_agent_start.output_rule: Keep experimental Surveyor changes lane-specific, publish a manifest + reproducible patch + tests, and never push experimental changes directly to main.

artifact_policy.github_role: manifests, patches, evidence, branches, PRs, source-state summaries

cross_mode_rule: Normal ChatGPT and Work/Codex must treat committed GitHub state as authoritative and may switch roles without relying on hidden conversation context.
